user.title: Connect Windmill
user.description: Enter the URL of your Windmill instance and a user token. The token requires at least the `users:read` permission.

data_description.base_url: Use {cloud_url} for Windmill Cloud, or enter the URL of your self-hosted instance. HTTP is supported, but transmits the token and data without encryption.
data_description.token: Use a token with only the permissions you need. Add `workspaces:read` to select the workspace from a list.

workspace.title: Select a workspace
workspace.description: Choose the workspace Home Assistant should use. If the token cannot list workspaces, enter the workspace ID manually.

data_description.workspace: Enter the workspace ID, not its display name.

capabilities.title: Connection verified

features.title: Select features
features.description: Choose which Windmill data and controls Home Assistant should provide. Features without the required permission or server support remain inactive.

data_description.detailed_health: Reads additional diagnostic data. The token must be allowed to access Windmill's detailed health endpoint.
data_description.worker_groups: Shows active workers and differing Windmill versions for each worker group.
data_description.worker_details: Creates a separate entity for every worker. This is primarily useful for self-hosted instances.
data_description.update_entity: Available only for self-hosted instances. Windmill Cloud is updated automatically.
data_description.runnable_buttons: Creates a button for every selected script or flow that has no input parameters. The run action remains available independently of this setting.
data_description.run_scope: Controls which jobs are included in sensors and events. Changing the scope does not report previous completions again.
data_description.runnable_details: Creates one device per selected script or flow with its last run, status, duration, and next scheduled run.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the Windmill token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new token for workspace {workspace} on {base_url}. The instance URL and workspace remain unchanged.

reconfigure.title: Change the Windmill connection
reconfigure.description: Change the instance URL or workspace. Leave the token empty to keep the stored token.

data_description.token: Optional. Leave this field empty to keep the stored token.

error.insufficient_permission: The token is not allowed to access this workspace.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.
error.invalid_workspace: The workspace is invalid or unavailable.
error.unexpected_response: The response from Windmill could not be processed.

abort.already_configured: This Windmill instance and workspace are already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The Windmill token has been updated.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Windmill connection has been updated.

runnables.title: Select scripts and flows
runnables.description: Only scripts and flows selected here can be run or monitored by Home Assistant. The list may be incomplete in very large workspaces.

data.pin_selected: Pin newly selected items to their current version

data_description.pin_selected: Stores the current hash for scripts and the current version for flows. Previously selected items keep their existing setting.

options.home_assistant_started: Only jobs started by Home Assistant

run.name: Run script or flow
run.description: Runs a selected Windmill script or flow asynchronously and returns the job ID.

config_entry_id.name: Windmill connection
config_entry_id.description: The instance and workspace in which the script or flow should run.

kind.name: Type
kind.description: Whether to run a script or a flow.

path.name: Path
path.description: Path of a script or flow selected in the integration options.

arguments.name: Arguments
arguments.description: Input values in JSON format. They are validated against the runnable's input schema.

cancel.name: Cancel job
cancel.description: Cancels a job that was started by Home Assistant and is still being tracked.

config_entry_id.name: Windmill connection
config_entry_id.description: The instance and workspace to which the job belongs.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: The job ID returned by the Run script or flow action.

unknown_config_entry.message: The selected Windmill connection no longer exists.

entry_not_loaded.message: The selected Windmill connection is not currently loaded.

runnable_not_selected.message: {path} is not selected in the Windmill integration options.

runnable_unsupported.message: The input parameters of {path} cannot be validated by this integration.

runnable_missing.message: The script or flow {path} no longer exists in Windmill.

invalid_arguments.message: The input values must be valid JSON data.

arguments_too_large.message: The input values are too large.

invalid_argument_type.message: A value of type {type} is required for {name}.

invalid_argument_value.message: The value for {name} is not allowed.

invalid_auth.message: Windmill rejected the token. Check the token or update the credentials.

insufficient_permission.message: The token is not allowed to run {path}.

unexpected_response.message: The response from Windmill could not be processed.

pin_unavailable.message: No version is available for {path}. Select the item again and disable version pinning.

job_not_tracked.message: Job {job_id} was not started by Home Assistant or is no longer being tracked.

job_not_cancellable.message: Job {job_id} has already finished or cannot be canceled.

insecure_transport.title: Windmill connection uses unencrypted HTTP
insecure_transport.description: The integration connects to `{host}` over HTTP. The token and job data are transmitted without encryption and can be read or modified on the network path. Use HTTPS whenever possible, for example through a TLS reverse proxy, and then update the integration URL.

missing_permission.title: An enabled feature is missing a permission
missing_permission.description: The token is not allowed to read `{capability}`, so the enabled `{feature}` feature cannot be used. Grant the required permission to the token or disable the feature in the integration options. This issue disappears automatically when access becomes available.

unsupported_capability.title: Windmill does not support an enabled feature
unsupported_capability.description: The Windmill instance does not provide the `{capability}` endpoint required by `{feature}`. Update Windmill or disable the feature in the integration options.

worker_version_drift.title: Worker group uses different Windmill versions
worker_version_drift.description: Worker group `{group}` has been using {versions} different Windmill versions for more than 30 minutes. This is expected during a rolling update. If the versions remain different, check whether one of the workers failed to update.
